relations.view:
SELECT bna.book_number AS calendar_number,
    b.book_key,
    b.title_english,
    b.title_arabic,
    b.testament,
    b.book_order
   FROM (bible.book_number_aliases bna
     JOIN bible.books b ON ((b.book_key = bna.book_key)))
  WHERE (bna.number_system = 'calendar_reference'::text);

relations.view:
SELECT e.coptic_month,
    e.coptic_day,
    d.coptic_month_name_english,
    d.coptic_month_name_arabic,
    e.entry_order,
    e.entry_key,
    e.title_english,
    e.title_arabic,
    t.line_order,
    t.english,
    t.arabic,
    e.source
   FROM ((synaxarium.entries e
     JOIN synaxarium.coptic_days d ON (((d.coptic_month = e.coptic_month) AND (d.coptic_day = e.coptic_day))))
     LEFT JOIN synaxarium.entry_texts t ON ((t.entry_key = e.entry_key)))
  ORDER BY e.coptic_month, e.coptic_day, e.entry_order, t.line_order;
